uniqueness_rules: At most one pending confirmation row may exist per mediation_record_id.
Confirmation rows become terminal or superseded inside the same engine-owned settlement transaction that resolves the mediation outcome.
expiry_behavior: Only rows in status=pending appear in the canonical mixed inbox.

When deadline_at passes without operator action, an engine-owned watchdog or recovery pass marks the confirmation row expired and settles the linked mediation as terminal_unverifiable with a confirmation_deadline_expired reason and clone_or_manual_fallback recovery action.
Expired, superseded, canceled, and resolved rows remain available for readback and audit but may not remain in approvals.list.

approvals_list.behavior: Return a mixed inbox keyed by subject_kind.
approvals_list.authoritative_read_rule: approvals.list unions canonical pending rows from approvals and canonical pending rows from lead_mediation_confirmations. GraphQL, projections, chainworks://approval resources, and report surfaces remain derived mirrors only and may not define freshness or pending-state truth.

approvals_resolve.compatibility_strategy: Additive wire-shape evolution under the existing tool name.
staleness_rules: The mediation branch must validate subject_id, mediation_record_id linkage, conflict_fingerprint, subject status, and idempotency_key at commit time.
Stale, terminal, canceled, or superseded items fail closed with a typed stale_or_terminal result.
